method: Four independent reference-image editing calls, one project plate per identity, transparent_background=true. Candidate PNGs were inspected before identical bytes were copied to the public paths. No Python drawing, alpha cleanup, repainting, resizing or pose synthesis was performed.

fidelity.reviewScope: Consistency with the four active project plates, recognizable color/anatomical signatures, ten distinct key poses and a genuinely prone final KO. This does not certify canonical anatomy, exact film/game motion, measured body ratios or original animation frame timing.
remaining: Primary orthographic and animation references remain absent for these four sheets.
The old plates are project fan imports, not verified primary franchise frames.
Two walking contacts and three primary-claw phases do not provide new special, super, jump, capture or paired choreography sheets.

grid.rectangles: Measured separately for each row; not equal fractional column cuts. The atlas data module is the authoritative runtime rectangle/anchor contract.
grid.scale: One identity scale computed from idle reference height, held constant across all ten poses including the prone KO.

alphaReview.technicalLimit: Low-alpha particles exist in some gutters. Variable cuts preserve all body pixels; only alpha<=1 specks can be crossed. Original PNG pixels remain untouched. This is not a strict-zero-alpha gutter claim.

sourceContext.scope: Aliens film identity/cast and published-image metadata only; no new primary pose or animation frame was recovered for this sheet.
Qualitative Prowler grapple/capability context only; no complete animation cycle, frame timing or 2D pose geometry.

images.pixelTransformation: none; exact copy of generated PNG
images.signatureReview: Black/gunmetal ridged elongated skull, rib cage, curved dorsal pipes, long narrow segmented tail and bipedal digitigrade legs.

frameReview.observation: Neutral silhouette and characteristic skull, torso, limbs and tail remain recognizable.
First forward locomotion contact is visibly distinct from idle.
Opposite limb contact differs from walk-a; no horizontal image flip is substituted.
Primary forelimb strike anticipation, with braced support and retracted striking limb.
Primary forelimb/claw reaches forward; no projectile, super effect or damage decal is drawn.
Forelimb and weight return from the strike in a pose distinct from idle and impact.
Defensive bracing brings forelimbs in front of the body without changing species identity.
Visible torso/head recoil differs from guard and attack; the actor remains supported.
Lowered collapse is drawn through bent limbs and descending head/chest; not a rotated static plate.
Final silhouette is genuinely horizontal and lying on its side, with low skull/torso and resting tail.

runtimeContract.boundsReview: All forty variable rectangles, silhouette alpha bounds and support anchors were measured from the actual generated PNGs. Root pivots were reviewed visually under the pelvis, including the four sideways KO poses; the pivot does not follow the tail bounding-box center. Runtime data remains the authoritative contract.
runtimeContract.identityVerifiedMeaning: Any positive identity review in the atlas contract refers only to consistency with the named project plate; it does not verify a primary franchise identity or certify canon 1:1.
